name: Split Button
description: A primary action joined to a menu of related alternatives.
usage:
<SplitButton
  label="Deploy"
  onClick={() => undefined}
  items={[{ id: 'staging', label: 'Deploy to staging', onSelect: () => undefined }]}
/>

anatomy.description: The button that fires the default action on click.
The chevron button named by menuLabel ("More actions" by default).
The list of alternative actions sharing the main action's context.

dos: Make the default the action most people want most of the time.
Keep alternatives to a handful of close variants of the same action.
Keep the main label short so the joined control stays on one line.
donts: Don't put unrelated actions in the menu; use separate buttons or a plain Menu.
Don't hide the only way to do something behind the chevron.

examples.title: Default plus alternatives
examples.description: The main action fires directly; the chevron opens the related menu.

examples.title: Secondary and danger variants
examples.description: The menu can carry a danger item behind the separator.

guidance.useWhen: One default action has a few close alternatives.
guidance.avoidWhen: The actions are unrelated; use separate buttons or a plain Menu.
guidance.behavior: The main button fires the default; the chevron owns the menu.
guidance.responsive: Keep the label short so the joined control stays one line.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the main action and then to the menu trigger.
Activates the focused half; the trigger opens the menu.
Closes the menu without selecting an item.

notes: The main action and the menu trigger are separate focus stops with separate accessible names.
The chevron trigger is named by menuLabel ("More actions" by default) and the menu shares that label.
Menu items follow menu keyboard behavior through the underlying Menu component.

apiEntries.description:

actions, joined into a single pill with a hairline seam.
